Title: Support for Azure API Management certificates in Azure Key Vault has reached general availability.

Body.Content:
With the integration of Azure API Management certificates in Azure Key Vault, you can now:

    • Reference Azure Key Vault certificates shared across services as certificates in Azure API Management.

    • Manage and rotate API Management’s certificates in Azure Key Vault.

    • Specify granular access policies for API Management’s certificates stored in Azure Key Vault.

    • Reuse certificates across services.

Supported certificate types are:

    • Client certificates for authenticating API requests to backend services.

    • Certificates to authenticate to Service Fabric backend services.

    • Certificates for authenticating API requests from self-hosted gateways to backend services.

    • Self-hosted gateway custom domain certificates.

Learn more.

Read the documenation.
